subject: Air freight quote to SGN
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN), including truck pickup from our site in 51149 (Bergisch Gladbach), Germany, and transfer to the airport?

The shipment is 6 pieces of laboratory glassware, 765 kg gross and 5.68 cbm, ready for pickup on 2026-11-24.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
